evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26hif (AT2026pjn), close to the nucleus of the galaxy CGCG012-055 at magnitude m_r = 17.1. At a distance of 96 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61202.26 (2026-06-11.26) with an absolute magnitude of M =-17.4 +/- 0.2. Forced photometry indicates some variability at this position, but forced photometry indicates that the source has brightened by >~2 magnitudes since MJD = 61199.94, and may still be rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
